atomic_cutover: One PR moves the identity handlers and the RequiresOperatorScope and RequiresActiveOperator middleware into modules/identityaccess/inbound/operator and deletes api/operator/auth.go, errors.go and identity.go. The only tenant.WithTenantID call in api/operator (school-account MFA administration) moves into modules/identityaccess/compose/mfa.go as operatorSchoolContext, allowed by identity-access.compose.tenant-runtime, so the school-scoped override and disable writes keep the same tenant context and the api/operator -> tenant key disappears. A missing school id is passed through unchanged; the application refuses it as before. api/operator keeps api.go and the foreign-owner composition until #2736.
